subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` opt-out for built-in `.agents/skills` roots, and should that contract be a general source list or a personal-source-only toggle?
rationale: The current behavior is source-reproducible, but fixing it adds public config surface and changes built-in skill discovery/watching semantics, which repository policy reserves for maintainer intent.

options.title: General source-disable list
options.body: Add a typed `skills.load.disabledSources`-style list for built-in source ids and apply it consistently across discovery, watcher registration, docs, and status surfaces.

options.title: Personal-source toggle only
options.body: Add a narrower boolean for `~/.agents/skills`, reducing API surface but leaving project `.agents/skills` and future source controls unresolved.

options.title: Decline new config
options.body: Keep current cross-agent discovery semantics and ask users to move or individually disable skills, accepting the reported prompt-bloat tradeoff.

recommendation.title: General source-disable list
recommendation.body: Add a typed `skills.load.disabledSources`-style list for built-in source ids and apply it consistently across discovery, watcher registration, docs, and status surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history connect this account to the refactored skills loader, watcher, and config schema surface where the decision would land.
